properties: copying a Log no longer double-closes the file (copy deleted, or ownership moved into a RAII member such as unique_ptr with a deleter)
the file is still closed exactly once

notes: The user-declared destructor closes the FILE*, but the implicit copy operations copy the pointer, so two Logs close it twice. C.21: define or delete all special members if you define one.
